result.title: Bayesian Evidence Accumulation for Graph-Based Learning in Dynamic Data-Driven Applications Systems
result.summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used in modern machine learning, yet most existing frameworks remain fundamentally static, limiting their applicability in Dynamic Data Driven Application Systems (DDDAS) where observations arrive sequentially under uncertainty. We introduce B-EAGLe (Bayesian Evidence Accumulation for Graph-Based Learning), a probabilistic framework inspired by CBGT-Net (cortico-basal ganglia-thalamic network) that reformulates graph classification as a sequential evidence accumulation process. B-EAGLe combines a GNN encoder with a Bayesian accumulator that incrementally updates posterior beliefs over class labels as new observations arrive, committing to a decision only when sufficient confidence is achieved. Experiments on CIFAR10 demonstrate competitive performance together with principled confidence estimation under sequential observations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 B-EAGLe：把图分类重构为序列证据累积过程，用 GNN 编码器配合 Bayesian 累加器，随观测顺序到达增量更新类标签后验，并在置信度足够时提交决策，在 CIFAR10 图上报告竞争性性能与置信度估计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「后验信念随证据增量更新 + 置信度达标即停止」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 判据与逐步累积的证据状态提供可核查的表述与评价参考；但对象是图分类而非多模态推理，迁移需自行判断。
